original.label: modern-lcdm-independence
original.luminosity_meaning: B(z)=0 fixed by assumption; zero width is not an empirical measurement.

reviewed_screen.interpretation: A total maximum centered difference <=0.1 implies pairwise relative likelihood changes no larger than exp(0.2) among these tested points only. Component flags detect large cancellations. Passing is only no large variation detected on this finite screen; failure requests further accuracy investigation. No gate on common offset alone.
reviewed_screen.limitations: Two accuracy levels do not establish asymptotic convergence.32 deterministic strata may miss tails, localized errors and remote modes. Stored baseline spectra are unavailable; full baseline component likelihoods are available. Higher-accuracy spectra are archived for later diagnosis only. Existing posterior qualification remains separate.

precision_review.limits: A supported finite screen means no large variation detected on these32 fixed chronological strata only. It is not posterior qualification, an accuracy-convergence guarantee, posterior reweighting, omitted covariance estimation or permission to erase the original failure. The consumer verifies arithmetic and provenance of stored backgrounds; their numerical computation was separately validated. No original pipeline receipt is changed.

limits: Explicit versioned receipt paths only; a future cohort or thermal review requires a new manifest, not trusted directory discovery.
The original finite-pipeline stopped_no_retry record is preserved. Supplemental invocation completion never implies scientific success.
Only the ordered quantile producer may replace its original producer; every other argv, output, source and condition must match the original plan.
Logs have no original producer digest; their bytes are pinned at audit time alongside completed, attempt and result receipts and rechecked before return.

Every child binds its full freshly qualified parent, sources and recursive cache/input hashes. Qualified histories at declared accuracy are separate from plotting-safe histories with supported finite native precision.

A thermal review is accepted only through freshly replayed native_precision_review_consumer.verify; original flags remain visible, genuine variation/failures block native-accuracy-supported plots and lensing.
A supported32point numerical screen is a limited diagnostic, not a new posterior qualification, convergence proof or precision guarantee across the entire posterior.
